text:
Jun: Heads-up: launched a 4% canary of v5.3-quant4-longdoc this AM. A/B against v5.1-fp16 shows a localized rerank MRR drop on >2k token inputs (~-10.8%) and p95 latency +27ms. No hallucination signal. My theory: cold KV + quant kernel jitter.

Ravi: quick numbers from the shadow window:
```
slice=longdoc_top20
baseline=v5.1-fp16 rerank_mrr=0.437
canary=v5.3-quant4 rerank_mrr=0.389
delta=-0.048 (-10.98%)
latency.p95: 168ms -> 195ms
kv_warmup_miss_rate: 0.7% -> 2.3%
```
Pattern spikes for session_prefixes with <6 warm requests.

Kim: our current canary policy uses mrr_drop=8% and halluc_abs=2%. For longdocs we should enforce a preflight plus a composite abort. Proposal: 1) run a synthetic preflight warmup (300 longdoc samples) against the canary pool before any ramp >1%; 2) add a composite gate "longdoc_guard" = 0.7*rerank_mrr_z + 0.2*latency_p95_z + 0.1*kv_miss_z, abort if < -1.2; 3) add a hard abort if rerank_mrr drops >5% OR latency_p95 increases >20ms OR kv_warmup_miss_rate >1.0%. Snippet to apply:```yaml
preflight:
  synthetic_warmup_samples: 300
  run_before_ramp_pct: 1
canary:
  percent: 4
auto_fallback:
  - metric: rerank_mrr_pct_drop
    threshold: 5.0
    window_sec: 600
  - metric: latency_p95_ms_abs
    threshold: 20
    window_sec: 600
  - metric: kv_warmup_miss_rate_pct
    threshold: 1.0
    window_sec: 600
composite_gates:
  - name: longdoc_guard
    formula: 0.7*rerank_mrr_z + 0.2*latency_p95_z + 0.1*kv_miss_z
    abort_threshold: -1.2
```
This would have tripped here.

Ravi: agree. Short-term mitigation: route override kv_warmup=12 for the canary pool so caches prefill. Also recommend we add a lightweight "logit_std_ratio" probe to the canary dashboard (if logit std >25% relative to baseline flag it).

Jun: doing the canary scale-down to 1% and kicking off the synthetic warmup job now. Patching rollout config with the composite gate and hard aborts.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2105 "v5.3-quant4 longdoc rerank degradation (canary)". Watchers: eng-ml, eng-platform.

Kim: next steps: 1) keep canary at 1% until warmed shadow completes, 2) collect logit_std_ratio + kernel traces, 3) if composite gate still below threshold rollback automatically; otherwise iterate on quant kernel tuning and repeat preflight. Tagging @dev-sre for warmup runner. :white_check_mark:
